# DeckBridge

> DeckBridge is a native macOS menu-bar app that bridges a Denon LC6000 PRIME controller to Syndicate, the DJ and performance software by Untitled Audio, over MIDI and OSC, with LED feedback.

## Pages

- [Home](https://getdeckbridge.app/): what DeckBridge does, features and requirements
- [Support](https://getdeckbridge.app/support/): setting up Syndicate, FAQ and contact
- [Privacy](https://getdeckbridge.app/privacy/): DeckBridge collects no data
